content:
**Frog Leg** is a consumable in *Fallout 76*.

The raw leg of a Frog which has been harvested off its corpse. Can be consumed raw to satisfy a small amount of hunger with a high dose of Radiation and disease chance. There is no recipe that uses this item so it cannot be cooked.

Has a 20% chance to be found on killed frogs. Use of the Butcher's Bounty perk gives a chance to find an additional piece.

Marked as an unsellable object which prevents selling to vendors but still allows buying and selling with other players.
